description: EEA Waterbase UWWTD Agglomerations publishes urban-area geospatial records reported under EU wastewater reporting. Its public final 2023 data-call release was published on 3 March 2026 and covers 2022 to 2023, with GeoPackage, geodatabase and map-service access. This resource is provided by European Environment Agency. Coverage is continental as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (EEA copyright notice: EEA materials are published under CC BY). The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Internal versions require Eionet authentication; the public final release is separate. The existing treatment-plant record names this as a sister dataset, but does not contain its urban-area records. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
